model_scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
model_scope.purpose: Run the P1 fixed-secondary-bias substage as five independently initialized top-primary transfer families while keeping the symmetric gate-capacitance ratio and all non-bias inputs fixed.
fixed_variables: top gate is the primary swept gate
Ctop/Cbottom parallel-plate proxy = 1 from symmetric 30 nm Al2O3 stacks
channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
no traps, recombination, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: trap, contact, geometry, dielectric, temperature, or mobility scans
any P2, P3, P4, or P5 run
experimental fitting or calibrated dual-gate prediction
physical capacitance-ratio, Ion, mobility, or uncertainty claims
compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

capacitance_ratio_control.boundary: This ratio is an input geometry proxy, not an extracted or experimentally validated physical capacitance ratio.

evidence_boundary_remains_bias_only_part.detail: T03-P1-BIAS may establish a reproducible five-point fixed-bottom-gate-bias sensitivity for the frozen symmetric E2 teaching model when the contract, numerical checks, T02-C zero-secondary reproduction, states, and independent checks pass.

limitations: All VTH, Delta VTH, gm, coupling, current, potential, and density values are numerical proxies from the frozen E2 teaching model.
Only fixed bottom-gate bias changes; the symmetric Ctop/Cbottom input proxy remains 1 and is not scanned or physically extracted.
No experiment calibration, physical capacitance ratio, physical Ion, traps, contact nonideality, temperature dependence, compact model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence is established.
Passing this run completes only T03-P1-BIAS, not complete P1 or complete T03.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: T03-P1-BIAS may establish a reproducible five-point fixed-bottom-gate-bias sensitivity for the frozen symmetric E2 teaching model when the contract, numerical checks, T02-C zero-secondary reproduction, states, and independent checks pass.
prohibited_claims: experimentally calibrated dual-gate response or process distribution
physical top-to-bottom capacitance ratio or capacitance-ratio sensitivity
physical Ion, mobility, hysteresis, or parameter uncertainty
trap, contact, geometry, dielectric, temperature, ferroelectric, compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only contract PASS permits this P1-BIAS run; only simulation plus independent persisted-evidence PASS completes this bias-only substage and permits a separate capacitance-ratio contract.
